headline: Everpeak Industries signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Everpeak Industries announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Everpeak Industries reports minor shipment delays at Rotterdam plant
body: Everpeak Industries confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Rotterdam plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.

headline: Everpeak Industries announces layoffs affecting 11% of workforce
body: Everpeak Industries said it will cut 11% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Everpeak Industries cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Everpeak Industries lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.
